title: ZaKo Cat Girl Paradise
description: It’s a server full of catgirls~ Welcome all catgirls to explore!
body:
🎉 欢迎来到 ZaKo 猫娘乐园！( ZaKo Cat Girl Paradise ) 🎉

嘘…你听，有“喵”声？🐱 没错，这里是一个被猫娘们占领的世界！
在这里，所有人聊天都会自带萌萌的“喵”，空气中都弥漫着可爱的气息～

✨ 在这个奇妙的世界里，你可以：

🐾 邂逅 & 驯服： 在各个宁静的村庄里，隐藏着一只只可爱的猫娘。找到属于你的那只，然后用你的魅力（和鱼干？）驯服她，让她成为你冒险旅途中最忠实的伙伴！

⚔️ 打造 & 强化： 想要变得更强？服务器特有的 【强化碳】 系统帮你实现！把心爱的装备和强化碳一起丢进熔炉里“烧”一下，就能见证奇迹，让你的武器和护甲突破极限！

📈 成长 & 突破： 想成为真正的强者？先在主世界通过原版方式努力升级到 Lv.50！一旦达成，就可以前往各种各样的副本，在那里你将获得神速升级的畅快体验，从此走向人生巅峰！

还等什么？这个世界正等待你的探索！
快来 ZaKo 猫娘乐园，开启只属于你的“猫娘大冒险” 吧！🚀

---

🎉 Welcome to ZaKo Cat Girl Paradise! 🎉

Shh… do you hear that? A "meow"? 🐱 That's right — this is a world taken over by cat girls!
Here,every message sent by players comes with a cute 'nya'~, and the air is filled with the sweetest, fluffiest vibes~

✨ In this wonderful world, you can:

🐾 Meet & Tame:
In peaceful villages all around, adorable cat girls are hiding. Find the one meant for you — and win her over with your charm (and maybe some dried fish?) — to make her your most loyal companion on all your adventures!

⚔️ Craft & Enhance:
Want to get stronger? The server’s exclusive Reinforcement Carbon system is here to help! Toss your favorite gear into a furnace along with some Reinforcement Carbon, give it a "burn," and witness the magic — push your weapons and armor beyond their limits!

📈 Grow & Break Through:
Dreaming of becoming a true hero? First, level up to Lv.50 the old-fashioned way in the overworld. Once you've made it, a variety of dungeons will open up before you — giving you the ultimate fast-track to power and glory!

What are you waiting for? This world is waiting to be explored!
Come to ZaKo Cat Girl Paradise and begin your very ownCat Girl Adventure! 🚀
